method.latency: Node monotonic elapsed from before physical Playwright input through asserted observable state; includes driver, actionability, polling and browser scheduling overhead. Not isolated CPU handler time.
method.frames: requestAnimationFrame timestamp deltas in foreground headless browser; not GPU presentation timestamps. Average FPS=1000/mean interval; median FPS=1000/median interval; 1% low=1000/mean slowest ceil(N*.01) intervals. Long frames strictly greater than stated thresholds. No GPU duration claim.
method.cold: Fresh browser context with browser HTTP cache cleared before navigation; OS disk cache is not cleared.
method.warm: Second navigation in same context with HTTP cache enabled.
